Survey statement (Hindi): जोया से मनौटा की करीब 14 किलोमीटर सड़क पर काम शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Work has started on the roughly 14 km road from Joya to Manauta
Basis: Amroha Dehat booth list on NIC 41-Amroha includes Joya block office polling station, so Joya is listed under AC 41; Manauta not checked. Article (Amar Ujala, 8 Oct 2026): Joya crossing to Manauta, about 14 km, repair work being started after rain halted it; Executive Engineer says work has begun on the Joya-Sambhal widening; carriageway 5.5 m widened to 7 m; about Rs 19 crore; no completion date

Survey statement (Hindi): दारानगर गांव में 2014 के बाद बिजली आई, अब रोशनी है
Voter says (English): Darana Nagar village got electricity after 2014, now there is light
Basis: District-level ground report (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026); Darana Nagar AC membership unconfirmed. Resident Mangat Singh says there was no light before 2014 and work on electricity began after that; article heading calls it a village in darkness since British times and a solar village under the Yogi government; claim is the resident's

Survey statement (Hindi): *फरासपुरा-अफजलपुर सड़क के लिए पहली किस्त आ गई
Voter says (English): *The first instalment has come for the Faraspura-Afzalpur road
Basis: Inference: funds and approval only, work not started. Amar Ujala (23 Sep 2026) explicitly names the Amroha Assembly area: Faraspura link road via Naseerpur bypass to Afzalpur road, Mukhyamantri Gramin Sadak Yojana, about 1.5 km, Rs 1.19 crore; first instalment released; work to start soon, no date

Survey statement (Hindi): *नगर पालिका के नए जुड़े वार्डों के लिए छह करोड़ मिले हैं
Voter says (English): *Rs 6 crore has been received for the newly added wards of the municipality
Basis: Inference: Executive Officer says Rs 6 crore received for newly added wards of Amroha municipality (Amar Ujala, 5 Apr 2026); drains in waterlogged areas, roads, street lights planned. Work not started, no start date, wards not named. Weak positive pending field check

Survey statement (Hindi): *प्रदेश की सड़कें पहले से अच्छी हुईं, आना-जाना आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): *State roads have become better than before and travel has become easier
Basis: Inference: one dholak trader (Deepak Agarwal, Hemlata Handicraft) in a district-level ground report (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026) says state roads have improved since the Yogi government and transport is easier. The quote is about the state, names no road or stretch in Amroha and gives no date. Opinion only, weak positive

Survey statement (Hindi): ट्रांसफार्मर खराब है, पीरगढ़ में 36 घंटे से बिजली नहीं, टंकियां खाली हैं
Voter says (English): The transformer is broken, Pirgarh has had no power for 36 hours, and the tanks are empty
Basis: Amroha city mohalla Pirgarh; AC 41 membership of the city confirmed by exclusion (AC 40 extent lists only KCs Naugawan Sadat and Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP) and city booths on the NIC 41-Amroha booth list. Article (Amar Ujala, 11 Oct 2026): 400 kVA transformer at Pirgarh failed on Friday afternoon (9 Oct), about 36 hours without supply; about 250 people and about 250 families both stated; residents say empty water tanks cause a drinking water shortage; SDO says a second transformer will be installed

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में कुत्तों ने 17 लोगों को काट लिया, इनमें आठ बच्चे हैं
Voter says (English): Stray dogs have bitten 17 people in the city, eight of them children
Basis: Amroha city mohallas Pirzada and Mullana (both on NIC 41-Amroha booth list), Chahmullana, Jhanda Shaheed. Attacks on Saturday 10 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala, 12 Oct 2026): 8 children and 9 others bitten; victims given anti-rabies vaccine at district hospital; residents fear a rabid dog; article reports no official response

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली जाते ही टंकी बंद, पांच मोहल्लों में पानी को तरसते हैं
Voter says (English): When power goes the tank stops, and people in five neighbourhoods are desperate for water
Basis: Five Amroha city mohallas: Lakshmanwali and Hussainpura Madhaiya are on NIC 41-Amroha booth list; Mehmadi Sarai, Chunni Wali Madhaiya, Imli Wali Madhaiya city mohallas. Amar Ujala, 3 Oct 2026: tanks run on electricity so supply stops during cuts; residents petitioned municipal chairman for solar lights and a generator; EO Dinesh Kumar says a generator-based supply will be arranged

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर के नाले गंदगी से भरे हैं, सफाई बस नाम की है
Voter says (English): Drains in the city are full of filth, and cleaning is only in name
Basis: Amroha city; Katkui, Nai Basti, Bijnor Road, Joya Road and Kailsa Road (Amroha city stretch) are on NIC 41-Amroha booth list; Chhebra, Beriyan, Atrasi Road, Mangalvar Bazar and Gandhi Murti crossing are city places, confirmed by city membership. Amar Ujala, 5 May 2026: drains clogged with waste, polythene and dirt; cleaning called token and only half done by residents; municipality's lakh-rupee cleaning claims submerged in light rain; article has no official response

Survey statement (Hindi): सुबोध नगर की सड़क पर गड्ढे और भरा पानी, बाइक सवार गिरकर घायल
Voter says (English): The Subodh Nagar road has potholes and standing water, and bike riders fall and get hurt
Basis: Subodh Nagar and Pushkar Nagar link road, Amroha dateline. Amar Ujala, 31 May 2026: potholes and standing water on the main road for a long time, water always pooled near a primary school, several bikers fallen and injured; residents say municipal and PWD officials have not acted. AC 41 membership of Subodh Nagar not confirmed (not on NIC booth list); article reports no official response

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे इलाके से गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे गुजरा, यह बड़ी बात है
Voter says (English): The Ganga Expressway passing through our area is a big thing
Basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 30 Apr 2026, reporting the PM's inauguration of the 594 km expressway in Hardoi): Hasanpur MLA Mahendra Singh Khadgavanshi said the expressway passing from here is a matter of good fortune for the area. This is the MLA's statement, not a voter's; no voter praise was found.

Survey statement (Hindi): राहरा रोड पर बिना रजिस्ट्रेशन चल रहा क्लीनिक सील हुआ, अच्छा हुआ
Voter says (English): An unregistered clinic on Rahra Road was sealed, and that is good
Basis: Amar Ujala (Moradabad Bureau, dateline Hasanpur, 7 Oct 2026): a health team sealed New Family Health Care Centre on Rahra Road for running without registration, and issued a notice (no sealing yet, children admitted) to Saloni Baal Clinic on the same road. The inspection followed complaints; the article does not say who complained. An enforcement action, not a voter's view.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हसनपुर में करीब 10 करोड़ की सात सड़कें मंजूर हुई हैं
Voter says (English): *Seven roads worth about Rs 10 crore in the Hasanpur area have been approved
Basis: Inference: approval only. Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 26 Aug 2026): about Rs 10 crore approved for seven roads (Agrola Kala crossroads to Fattehpur, Sohraka to Allipur Milak, and five others), on MLA Mahendra Khadgavanshi's proposal. The article uses future tense and does not say any road has started or finished. No voter view found; field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हसनपुर की तीन सड़कों की मरम्मत मंजूर हो गई, टेंडर भी लग गया
Voter says (English): *Repair of three roads in the Hasanpur area has been approved and tendering has started
Basis: Inference: approval and tendering only. Amar Ujala (Amroha, 11 Sep 2026): PWD approved repair of nine roads in the district, three of them in the Hasanpur area (Sambhal-Dayarsi to Pandika crossing, Rahra-Gaya to Dehri Khadar, Aitmali to Kasaipura). The article says tendering has started but no repair work is reported, and the PWD XEN said work would finish in 30 days if it does not rain. Weak positive; field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सीएचसी में घायल बच्चे को पहला इलाज मिला
Voter says (English): *The CHC gave an injured child first aid
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 19 Jun 2026) shows the community health centre gave an injured child first aid and referred him to the district hospital. No resident praised the CHC and no later report was found. Weakest positive; field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): 10 घंटे बिजली बंद रही, पीने के पानी तक की दिक्कत हुई
Voter says (English): Power was cut for 10 hours in Hasanpur and drinking water also became a problem
Basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 13 Apr 2026): supply was cut from about 9 AM to about 7:45 PM on 12 Apr 2026 for replacing a VCB at the 33/11 kV Hasanpur Town substation. The report says the lack of power caused drinking-water problems. Residents are not quoted. AC membership: the substation serves Hasanpur town, the AC's namesake; no source found lists the AC extent, so this is taken from the namesake only.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा कुत्ते बच्चों को काट रहे हैं, शिकायत पर कोई कार्रवाई नहीं होती
Voter says (English): Stray dogs are attacking children, and complaints lead to no action
Basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 19 Jun 2026), Abdullah Colony on Sambhal Road: a pack of stray dogs mauled a 7-year-old deaf-mute boy on Thursday night. Residents said stray dogs had attacked three children in four months and that written and verbal complaints to the nagar palika had led to no action. These are residents' allegations as reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): हसनपुर के खुले नालों में गिरकर लोग घायल होते हैं, पालिका गंभीर नहीं
Voter says (English): People fall into the open drains in Hasanpur and get hurt, and the municipality is not serious
Basis: Amar Ujala (dateline Hasanpur, 16 Jul 2026): deep open drains on main roads and in dense mohallas, named spots HS Public School road, Rahra Adda to Sambhal Adda, Ambedkar Chowk to hospital road and the truck union bypass. Two- and four-wheeler riders fell in at night and were hurt; residents say there have been earlier deaths and accuse the municipality of not being serious. Municipal board chairman Rajpal Saini said barricading of open drains will start soon, with no timeline. Residents' allegations as reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): गन्ने के करोड़ों रुपये बकाया हैं, भुगतान अटका पड़ा है
Voter says (English): The sugarcane payment is stuck and crores of rupees are still owed
Basis: District-level, not Hasanpur-specific: Amar Ujala (Amroha, 27 Jul 2026) says three mills owe Rs 44.67 crore in total: Web Sugar Mill Dhanaura over Rs 39 crore, Rana Sugar Mill Belwara about Rs 4 crore, Karimganj Sugar Mill Shahabad Rs 1.67 crore. Hasanpur mill is named only among the ten mills Amroha farmers supply, not among those with dues.

Survey statement (Hindi): हसनपुर-राहरा रोड पर गहरे गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल होता है
Voter says (English): The Hasanpur to Rahra road has deep potholes and is hard to get through in the rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (Moradabad Bureau, 2 Oct 2026): after two days of rain, the Hasanpur-Rahra road has deep potholes, worst near Rustampur Khadar; two-wheeler riders slip and get injured. The Hasanpur end is in the AC town; whether Rustampur Khadar and Rahra lie inside the AC is not confirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific. The same article's jam report refers to Amroha city roads, not this road.

Survey statement (Hindi): कालंद, मैनापूठी और हर्रा में इंटरलॉकिंग रास्ते बन गए हैं
Voter says (English): Interlocking roads have been built in Kalind, Mainaputhi and Harra
Basis: Siwalkhas MLA Haji Gulam Mohammad inaugurated about Rs 61.45 lakh of works: interlocking-tile roads in Kalind (Rs 27.31 lakh), Mainaputhi (Rs 16.96 lakh) and Harra (Rs 17.18 lakh). The report names the Siwalkhas assembly seat, so the villages are inside AC 43 per the report. Verified 2026-10-11.

Survey statement (Hindi): कालंद और पिठलोकर में करीब 20 लाख के रास्ते बन गए
Voter says (English): Roads costing about Rs 20 lakh have been built in Kalind and Pithlokar
Basis: Siwalkhas MLA inaugurated about Rs 20 lakh of schemes: an interlocking road from one house to the main road in Kalind (Rs 10 lakh, MLA's constituency fund) and a road from one house to another in Pithlokar (Rs 10 lakh; article spells it Pitholokar; funding source not stated). Article places the works in Sardhana development block, Sarurpur area. Dated 20 Aug 2025 (event on Tuesday, 19 Aug). The URL is a video page, but the fetched page carries a written article.

Survey statement (Hindi): पूठखास के पांडेश्वर महादेव मंदिर में पर्यटन का काम हो गया
Voter says (English): Tourism development work at the Pandeshwar Mahadev temple in Puthkhas is done
Basis: Tourism minister Jaiveer Singh inaugurated the tourism development work at the Pandeshwar Mahadev temple in village Puthkhas, Rohta development block, Siwalkhas assembly constituency, costing Rs 58.10 lakh. Article dated 14 Mar 2026. This was a state minister's event, not the MLA's.

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरठ की पांच चीनी मिलों ने 229 करोड़ का गन्ना भुगतान कर दिया
Voter says (English): Five of Meerut's six sugar mills have cleared Rs 229 crore of cane payments
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific. ChiniMandi (2 Dec 2025, citing Amar Ujala): five of six Meerut district mills have cleared payments totalling Rs 229 crore for cane procured up to 22 Nov (Daurala 87.99, Mawana 75.83, Nanglamal 36.10, Mohiuddinpur 15.76, Sakhoti 13.30 crore). The one lagging mill is Kinauni, which has received notices.

Survey statement (Hindi): *इंटरलॉकिंग रास्तों से गांव के अंदर आना-जाना आसान हो सकता है
Voter says (English): *Interlocking roads may make it easier to move inside the villages
Basis: Inference: no source records residents' reaction to the interlocking roads. The fetched Oct 2026 article quotes only the MLA, and the Aug 2025 article records no resident reaction either. The point is drawn from the interlocking roads inaugurated in Kalind, Mainaputhi, Harra and Pithlokar. Searches for a sourced replacement found nothing.

Survey statement (Hindi): पिठलोकर में मुख्य रास्ते पर दस साल से पानी भरता है, निकासी नहीं
Voter says (English): The main road in Pithlokar has been waterlogged for about ten years, with no drainage
Basis: Villagers say the main road has been waterlogged for about ten years, with no proper drainage and no cleaning, so walking is hard in the rain. They say they complained several times to the gram pradhan and the Siwalkhas MLA. Article dated 23 Sep 2026 (Sarurpur development block). AC 43 is confirmed because the article names the Siwalkhas MLA, and Sarurpur is in the Saroorpur KC listed in the AC 43 extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना-बिनौली सड़क पर हर्रा में गड्ढों में पानी, हादसे का डर
Voter says (English): On the Sardhana-Binauli road in Harra, potholes are full of water and there is fear of accidents
Basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): Baghpat MP Rajkumar Sangwan inspected the Sardhana-Binauli road at the outer edge of Harra, a qasba near Sarurpur. Locals said waterlogging is long-running and worsens after rain, and water in the potholes hides their depth. Also complaints about parking and encroachment. The MP directed PWD to fix it immediately. The Sep article does not name an AC. Harra is inside AC 43 per the Amar Ujala 11 Oct 2026 report that names the Siwalkhas seat and the MLA's works in Harra.

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना, फलावदा, दौराला, लावर में कटौती और कम वोल्टेज, खेतों की सिंचाई रुकी
Voter says (English): Power cuts and low voltage in Sardhana, Phalawda, Daurala and Lawar have stopped irrigation of fields
Basis: District/tehsil-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala (24 May 2026): an SP delegation led by Seema Pradhan submitted a memorandum to the PVVNL MD on Saturday (23 May 2026, weekday-derived). It cites excessive cuts and low voltage in Sardhana, Phalawda, Daurala, Lawar and nearby villages. Farmers cannot irrigate, and transformers burn out in the heat. The MD promised a quick fix. Sardhana town is not in the AC 43 extent (Saroorpur KC and Karnawal NP of Sardhana tehsil), and it is the seat of AC 44. AC 43 membership of the named villages is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जसड़ सुल्तान नगर का पुराना तालाब छलकने को है, सालों से सफाई नहीं
Voter says (English): The old pond in Jasad Sultan Nagar is nearly overflowing and has not been cleaned for years
Basis: Amar Ujala video page with written article (6 Aug 2025): villagers say the old pond in Jasad Sultan Nagar, a locality of Sarurpur village, is nearly overflowing after continuous rain, has not been cleaned for several years and has turned into marsh. They say there is no proper drainage, and that complaints to officials have gone unanswered. Allegations of land grabbing by influential people are reported as villagers' claims. No official responds in the article. AC 43 membership is inferred from Sarurpur being in the Saroorpur KC listed in the AC 43 extent. Neither the article nor the KC extent names the assembly.

Survey statement (Hindi): बस्तौरा नारंग में श्मशान घाट नहीं, हर साल बारिश-बाढ़ में रास्ते टूटते हैं
Voter says (English): Bastaura Narang has no cremation ground, and access roads break every year in rain and floods
Basis: Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026): in Bastaura Narang, a flood-prone Ganga khadar village, an 80-year-old woman's funeral procession waded through 2-3 feet of water. The village has no cremation ground, so the last rites were held about 10 km away in Hastinapur. Access roads are damaged every year in rain and floods, and villagers want a raised CC road. The article does not name the tehsil, block or assembly. AC membership is unconfirmed: searches found no source placing Bastaura Narang in any AC. Meerut district only.

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना में दौराला रोड की पुलिया पर रैंप का काम शुरू हुआ
Voter says (English): Ramp work has started on the Daurala Road culvert in Sardhana
Basis: AC membership unconfirmed for Sardhana town (see notes); article datelined Sardhana, 24 May 2026: ramp work began on Sunday on the under-construction Daurala Road culvert; residents said the culvert without a ramp caused frequent accidents. No completion date given; article says relief comes once ramp is complete

Survey statement (Hindi): नगर पालिका में सात दिन का शिविर, मौके पर योजनाओं का लाभ
Voter says (English): A seven-day camp at the Nagar Palika gives welfare scheme benefits on the spot
Basis: AC membership unconfirmed for Sardhana town (see notes); article datelined Sardhana, 5 Oct 2026: seven-day Sewa Sankalp camp inaugurated at Nagar Palika premises; health, social welfare and education officials try to get state scheme benefits on the spot; many residents visit daily; no scheme named

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना में सेंट जोसेफ कॉलेज की लो वोल्टेज खराबी ठीक, बिजली सामान्य
Voter says (English): The low-voltage fault at St Joseph college in Sardhana was fixed and power is back to normal
Basis: AC membership unconfirmed for Sardhana town (see notes); article datelined Sardhana, 18 Jul 2026: power corporation team removed a technical fault after low-voltage complaints at St Joseph Girls Degree College and restored normal supply; SDM ordered inquiry. One incident at one college, not a town-wide fix

Survey statement (Hindi): *सरधना की 50 सड़कों को 2023 में मंजूरी मिली
Voter says (English): *Approval for 50 roads in Sardhana was given in 2023
Basis: Inference: approval only, 8 Feb 2023 (date and figures confirmed on fetch). Article names Sardhana Vidhan Sabha constituency: 50 roads, 87 km, Rs 14.23 crore, approved on a proposal by Union minister Sanjeev Balyan (granted by PWD minister Jitin Prasad); work described in future tense; Daurala-Sardhana road renovation (about Rs 3.71 crore) named as planned. No completion report found; weak positive pending field check

Survey statement (Hindi): *मेरठ की पांच चीनी मिलों ने बकाया चुका दिया, किसानों को राहत
Voter says (English): *Five Meerut sugar mills have paid cane dues, which gives farmers some relief
Basis: Inference: district-level, not Sardhana-specific. ChiniMandi, 2 Dec 2025 (fetched): five of six Meerut-region mills (Daurala, Mawana, Nanglamal, Mohiuddinpur, Sakhoti) cleared dues for cane procured up to 22 Nov, Rs 229 crore in total; District Cane Officer said only Kinauni mill is lagging. Sardhana and its serving mill are not named

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना में तहसील रोड पर खुदाई से लाइन फटी, सुबह से नल सूखे
Voter says (English): Digging on Tehsil Road in Sardhana burst the line, and taps have been dry since morning
Basis: Sardhana town, Tehsil Road (AC membership unconfirmed, see notes). Amar Ujala, 10 Apr 2026 (fetched, datelined Sardhana): Jal Nigam was laying a new pipeline when the old line was damaged; taps dry since morning; large part of town affected (headline says half, body gives no figure); supply not fully restored when written; residents blamed careless digging; chairperson Sabila Begum blamed Jal Nigam disorder

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में तहसील रोड, लश्करगंज में पानी भर जाता है, पैदल निकलना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): When it rains, Tehsil Road and Lashkarganj fill with water and walking through is hard
Basis: Sardhana town (AC membership unconfirmed, see notes). Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026 (fetched, datelined Sardhana): after heavy rain, waterlogging on Tehsil Road, Ashok ki Laat, Gujran Gate, Ramleela Ground, Lashkarganj, Kalandh Chungi; pedestrians waded; two-wheeler and e-rickshaw drivers struggled; shopkeepers said fewer customers; residents asked for permanent fix; no official response reported

Survey statement (Hindi): पाइपलाइन के लिए खुदी सड़कें कई वार्डों में मरम्मत की राह देख रहीं
Voter says (English): Roads dug for pipelines in many wards are waiting for repair
Basis: Sardhana Nagar Palika, 25 wards (AC membership unconfirmed, see notes). Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026 (fetched, datelined Sardhana): about 70 km Amrit 2.0 pipeline, about Rs 35 crore, two years; damaged roads listed in 13 wards incl. Mandi Chamaran, Town Hall Road, Gujran Gate; councillors say uneven lanes hard for two-wheelers; Jal Nigam JE said repairs after monsoon, all work by February next year; 70% completion is a claim

Survey statement (Hindi): सरधना नगर पालिका में खरीद-भुगतान में गड़बड़ी का आरोप है, जांच हो
Voter says (English): There is an allegation of irregularity in purchases and payments at the Sardhana municipality; an inquiry should be held
Basis: Sardhana Nagar Palika (AC membership unconfirmed, see notes). Amar Ujala, 1 Oct 2026 (fetched, datelined Sardhana): Bhrashtachar Nivaran Regulation Front alleged about Rs 50 crore GeM irregularity, about Rs 10 crore drain payments, about Rs 55 crore pipeline scrutiny, repeated garbage-depot payments, two Amrit pond tenders; Congress leader Jitendra Panchal backed an inquiry; no municipal response; allegations only

Survey statement (Hindi): मंडी चमारान और प्रभात नगर में ट्रांसफार्मर खराब, कई दिन बिजली की दिक्कत
Voter says (English): Transformer fault in Mandi Chamaran and Prabhat Nagar, power problems for several days
Basis: Sardhana town localities Mandi Chamaran and Prabhat Nagar (AC membership unconfirmed, see notes). Amar Ujala video page, Friday 3 Jul 2026 (fetched; date taken from URL, page shows no visible date): irregular supply for several days after transformer failure; repeated complaints; residents staged dharna and warned of stronger agitation; no action by power company reported

Survey statement (Hindi): मवाना मिल ने 7 जनवरी तक 311 करोड़ से ज्यादा गन्ना भुगतान किया
Voter says (English): Mawana sugar mill has paid over Rs 311 crore for cane bought up to 7 January
Basis: Mill (Mawana, Meerut) paid Rs 311.34 crore total cane price for cane bought up to 7 January 2026 (2025-26 season); 88.91 lakh quintal crushed up to 16 January. Mawana MB is inside AC 45 per Wikipedia extent (article dated 17 Jan 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): किसानों के विरोध के बाद जलनिकासी हुई, अब सड़क की मरम्मत शुरू
Voter says (English): After farmers protested over waterlogging, drainage was done and road repair has started
Basis: After farmers cut part of the Hastinapur-Chandpur link road over waterlogging, drainage work was carried out by agreement with administration and PWD began repairs (18 July 2026). AC membership of this road segment unconfirmed (Chandpur is in Bijnor)

Survey statement (Hindi): स्टेट बैंक चौराहे से भारत माता पार्क तक सड़क बननी शुरू हुई
Voter says (English): Road construction has started from State Bank crossing to Bharat Mata Park
Basis: Construction began after bhoomi pujan by Nagar Panchayat chairperson Sudha Khatik; completion not reported (26 November 2025)

Survey statement (Hindi): कस्बे की ज्यादातर मुख्य सड़कें सीसी हो गई हैं
Voter says (English): Most of the town's main roads have already been made CC roads
Basis: Nagar Panchayat chairperson Sudha Khatik said most main roads have already been converted to CC roads (3 May 2026). This is the chairperson's own claim, not independently verified; treat as weak positive and check on the ground

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में करीब 44 जगह कूलर लगे, पर छह से ज्यादा खराब हैं
Voter says (English): About 44 water coolers have been installed in the town, but more than six are out of order
Basis: Nagar Panchayat has installed water coolers at about 44 locations; more than half a dozen are out of order (31 May 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा कटान में खेत बह गए, प्रशासन ने ठोस इंतजाम नहीं किए
Voter says (English): Ganga erosion has swallowed fields, and the administration has not made solid arrangements
Basis: About 10,000 farmers affected, about 5,000 hectares of crops completely destroyed, over 2,000 hectares of land swallowed by the Ganga; article says no solid administrative arrangement made so far ('अब तक कोई ठोस कदम नहीं उठाया गया है'). Article places it in Hastinapur but names no tehsil or block; named villages Bastota Narang, Makhdumpur, Kishorpur, Jalalpur Jora - AC membership unconfirmed, so not counted (8 Sept 2025)

Survey statement (Hindi): करीब 16 करोड़ खर्च, फिर भी बारिश में सड़कों पर पानी भरता है
Voter says (English): Despite about Rs 16 crore spent, roads get waterlogged whenever it rains
Basis: Article says tourism department spent about Rs 16 crore (करीब 16 करोड़ रुपये की लागत) on Hastinapur town roads, with stone slabs placed, but adequate rainwater drainage arrangements were not made and several major routes flood when it rains (28 July 2026). Hastinapur town is inside AC 45 (Nagar Panchayat)

Survey statement (Hindi): गन्ना भुगतान में देरी का ब्याज कितना बना, उसका हिसाब दो
Voter says (English): Farmers demand a year-wise statement of interest on delayed sugarcane payments
Basis: Rashtriya Kisan Mazdoor Sangathan farmers sat in at Mawana Sahkari Ganna Vikas Samiti demanding year-wise interest statement on cane payments delayed over 14 days (1996-97 to 2025-26), citing a High Court order; deputy promised written reply on 7 October. Mawana MB is inside AC 45 per Wikipedia extent (5 Oct 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्डों की जर्जर सड़कों की मरम्मत अभी इंतजार में है
Voter says (English): Repair of dilapidated ward roads is still pending
Basis: Article (3 May 2026): DPR for about 25 roads in various wards prepared and sent to the state government; construction to start after final approval. Chairperson Sudha Khatik, Hastinapur Nagar Panchayat

Survey statement (Hindi): भीषण गर्मी में कूलर खराब पड़े हैं, यहां लोग प्यासे हैं
Voter says (English): Coolers are out of order in the scorching heat and people here are thirsty
Basis: More than half a dozen Nagar Panchayat coolers out of order, most not cleaned in two years; resident quote 'यहां जनता प्यासी है' (31 May 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): *गंगा बांध से एक दर्जन से ज्यादा गांवों की फसल बाढ़ से बची
Voter says (English): *Ganga embankment kept crops in more than a dozen villages safe from flooding
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Meerut report (11 Oct 2026, Meerut Bureau) says the Irrigation Department's Ganga embankment protected crops in more than a dozen villages from flooding. The report is about the Hastinapur khadar area (Hastinapur, Tarapur, Latifpur, Fatehpur Prem, Mundali, Mawana). It names Machhra and Rajpura blocks as the storm area but no Kithore village. AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *मवाना मिल ने जनवरी तक गन्ने का 311 करोड़ से ज्यादा भुगतान किया
Voter says (English): *Mawana sugar mill has paid over Rs 311 crore for cane bought up to 7 January 2026
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Meerut report (17 Jan 2026): Mawana Chini Mill sent Rs 18.98 crore to cane committees for cane bought 4-7 Jan and has paid Rs 311.34 crore for cane bought through 7 Jan in the 2025-26 season. Mawana town is not named in the Kithore extent (only Kithore NP of Mawana tehsil is). Mill-level figure, not a per-farmer figure. AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *ईकड़ी रोड पर नाला और सीसी सड़क बन गई, पानी नहीं भरा
Voter says (English): *Ikdi Road now has a drain and CC road, and water did not collect
Basis: Inference: Sardhana-datelined Amar Ujala report (23 Sep 2026): drain and road work on Ikdi Road is complete and an SDM-ordered on-site inspection found no waterlogging. The article does not name Kithore, Kharkhauda, Machhra, Rajpura or Mawana, and Sardhana is not in the Kithore extent. AC membership unconfirmed, and probably outside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सरूरपुर सीएचसी के नए भवन में पैथोलॉजी लैब शुरू हो गई है
Voter says (English): *The pathology lab has started in the new Sarurpur CHC building
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Meerut report (24 Sep 2026, Sarurpur dateline): the pathology lab has started in the new CHC building and patients in the area are expected to get relief. A new testing machine is still to be started. Sarurpur is not named in the Kithore extent and the article does not name Kithore. AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश और ओलों में गन्ने की फसल का अब तक ज्यादा नुकसान नहीं
Voter says (English): *Sugarcane crop has so far not suffered much damage from the rain and hail
Basis: Inference: same Amar Ujala Meerut report (11 Oct 2026) on the Machhra and Rajpura block area: sugarcane has so far not suffered major damage. This is relief from a risk, not a delivered benefit, so it is the weakest positive. AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): माछरा में बारिश का पानी भरा, कटा धान उसी में तैर रहा
Voter says (English): In Machhra rainwater has collected and cut paddy is floating in it
Basis: Amar Ujala Meerut report (11 Oct 2026): after rain and hail, cut paddy was seen floating in rainwater in Machhra; farmers fear long-term waterlogging will lower crop quality. Machhra is inside the AC at KC level: Wikipedia's Kithore extent lists KC Machhara (Mawana tehsil). Village-by-village membership of Machhra in KC Machhara not checked. The same report quotes the SDM saying hail caused no major loss in the khadar area.

Survey statement (Hindi): *गन्ने का बकाया भुगतान समय पर नहीं मिल रहा, किसान नाराज़ हैं
Voter says (English): *Pending sugarcane dues are not being paid on time and farmers are angry
Basis: Inference: Meerut district-level report (ChiniMandi, 2 Sep 2026): BKU protest at Commissioner's Chowk demanded timely payment of pending sugarcane dues, a fair cane price, power and fertiliser supply. No Kithore or Kharkhauda mill and no dues amount named. District-level, not AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): *खरखौदा के बूचड़खाने का गंदा पानी कली नदी में जाने का आरोप है
Voter says (English): *Allegedly, waste from the Kharkhauda slaughterhouse flows into the Kali river
Basis: Inference: Swarajya ground report dated 2 Feb 2019 (old; not 2024-2026). It says one long-running plant's waste went into local drains that drained into Kali Nadi, in the Kharkhauda area (Kharkhauda KC and NP are inside the AC). Named villages (Kaul, Allipur, Setkuan, Peepli Kheda, Bijauli, Bahrampur) are not confirmed inside the AC. Persistence not shown: 2024-2026 searches on Kharkhauda and Kali Nadi found nothing, so flagged as inference under the old-source rule. Allegations stay allegations.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कौल के हैंडपंप का पानी गन्ने के रस जैसा दिखता है, आरोप है
Voter says (English): *Water from a Kaul hand-pump could pass for sugarcane juice by its colour, allegedly
Basis: Inference: same 2019 Swarajya report. It says a Kaul hand-pump's water could pass off as sugarcane juice by its colour, and an Allipur hand-pump looked yellowish. Old source; persistence not shown in 2024-2026 searches; named villages not confirmed inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): *खरखौदा के पास गांवों में कैंसर बुखार जैसा आम, आरोप है
Voter says (English): *Residents allege cancer is as common as fever in villages near Kharkhauda
Basis: Inference: same 2019 Swarajya report. Residents say cancer is as common as fever and that at least 40 people died of cancer in nearby villages in the last year. This is a residents' claim, not a medical finding. Old source; persistence not shown; named villages not confirmed inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगानगर की वार्ड 37 में इंटरलॉकिंग सड़कें बनीं
Voter says (English): Interlocking roads built in Ganganagar ward 37 with MLA's fund
Basis: Newsprahari (undated, URL month 2026-05): MLA Amit Agarwal inaugurated about Rs 60 lakh of roads and drains from his MLA fund, including 180 m and 230 m interlocking roads in ward 37 Ganganagar and Global City Colony. Ward 37 is listed in the AC extent on Wikipedia

Survey statement (Hindi): कंकरखेड़ा में विधायक निधि से सड़क और नाली बनीं
Voter says (English): Roads and drains built in Kankarkhera from MLA's fund
Basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, Sunday 7 June 2026, 05:54 PM): Cantt MLA Amit Agarwal inaugurated about Rs 33.67 lakh of road and drain work from his MLA fund in the Kankarkhera area (New Govindpuri, Ganpati Vihar, Nangla Tashi named)

Survey statement (Hindi): शर्मा नगर में 1300 मीटर लंबी इंटरलॉकिंग सड़क बनी
Voter says (English): A 1,300-metre interlocking road built in Sharma Nagar from MLA's fund
Basis: Amar Ujala (Sanvad, Meerut, 15 Oct 2025): 1,300 m interlocking road in Sharma Nagar (Bhamashah Park) built from MLA fund for about Rs 15.62 lakh; the article reports residents welcomed it. AC membership of Sharma Nagar not confirmed in the Wikipedia extent

Survey statement (Hindi): दुर्गा नगर कैलाशपुरी और संजय नगर में सड़कें बनीं
Voter says (English): Roads built in Durga Nagar Kailashpuri and Sanjay Nagar from MLA's fund
Basis: Newsprahari (undated, URL month 2026-05): 100 m road in ward 67 Durga Nagar Kailashpuri and 100 m road in ward 46 Sanjay Nagar, part of about Rs 60 lakh MLA-fund works. Wards 67 and 46 are listed in the AC extent on Wikipedia

Survey statement (Hindi): दुर्गानगर की गली में 100 मीटर इंटरलॉकिंग सड़क बनी
Voter says (English): A 100-metre interlocking road built in a Durganagar lane
Basis: Amar Ujala (Sanvad, Meerut, 15 Oct 2025): 100 m interlocking road in Virendra Tomar lane, Durganagar (Patel Nagar mandal, Garh Road), built from MLA fund for about Rs 8 lakh. AC membership of this locality not confirmed in the Wikipedia extent

Survey statement (Hindi): सदर बाजार के व्यापारियों को सीलिंग और तोड़फोड़ का डर सता रहा है
Voter says (English): Sadar Bazar traders fear sealing and demolition of their shops
Basis: ETV Bharat (1 Oct 2026): Supreme Court order to seal and demolish 16,726 illegal constructions in Zone-A of Meerut city; traders from Sadar Bazar, Khairnagar, Sarafa, Kagzi Bazar and Lala ka Bazar sought an ordinance and warned of street protests. Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026): about 17,000 black flags put up over three days by the Sanyukt Vyapar Sangh. Sadar Bazar AC membership not confirmed; district-level

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगानगर में नाले का काम कई हफ्तों से रुका, खुला गड्ढा खतरनाक
Voter says (English): Drain work in Ganganagar has been stalled for weeks and the open pit is dangerous
Basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): PWD drain work in Ganganagar stalled for 17 days near Hotel Royal 9, leaving an open pit with risk of someone falling at night and mosquito breeding. Amar Ujala (3 Jul 2026): stalled for 19 days, with barricades, warning boards and lighting missing. Ganganagar is ward 37, which lies inside the AC per the Wikipedia extent and Newsprahari

Survey statement (Hindi): कंकरखेड़ा में बिना सूचना चार-चार घंटे बिजली कटौती का आरोप है
Voter says (English): Power is cut for four hours at a time in Kankarkhera without notice, residents allege
Basis: ETV Bharat (28 Jun 2026, 12:39 PM): Kankarkhera residents took to the streets, alleging 4-hour cuts without prior notice, and said officials ignore complaints; no official response reported. Kankarkhera AC membership is not on the Wikipedia extent list; it rests on the Amar Ujala 7 Jun 2026 report of Cantt MLA fund works in the Kankarkhera area, so a field check is advisable

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगानगर, सदर, पटेल नगर में हर साल बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Rainwater stands in Ganganagar, Sadar and Patel Nagar every year
Basis: Newsprahari (dated 9 July 2026 in the article, year from URL): Cantt MLA Amit Agarwal inspected waterlogged areas including Ganganagar, Sadar, Patel Nagar, Begumpul, Jali Kothi, Lalkurti and Rajban, and said areas that flood every year need a long-term plan. Ganganagar is ward 37 (inside AC per Wikipedia extent). Sadar and Patel Nagar membership is not on the extent list; implied only by the MLA's inspection

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरठ में कई इलाकों में तीन से पांच घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है
Voter says (English): Power goes off for three to five hours in several Meerut areas
Basis: Amar Ujala (Meerut bureau, 24 Jun 2026, 10:01 PM): power cuts of three to five hours in many parts of the city; areas named include Kankarkheda, TP Nagar, Garh Road and Khairnagar; a Dawa Market chemists' leader said business and equipment were affected. District-level, not AC-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरठ में मेट्रो और नमो भारत चलने लगी, बेगमपुल भी मुख्य स्टेशनों में
Voter says (English): Metro and Namo Bharat trains have started in Meerut, and Begumpul is one of the main stations
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026): 'नमो भारत ट्रेन का सफल संचालन शुरू हो गया है'; city has 4 Namo Bharat and 13 Metro stations; Begumpul is named among the main stations after Meerut South (city-level, not AC-specific)

Survey statement (Hindi): दिल्ली से मेरठ का सफर अब 55 मिनट में हो सकता है
Voter says (English): Delhi to Meerut can now be done in about 55 minutes
Basis: Punjab Kesari (22 Feb 2026): PM launched Namo Bharat on the entire Delhi-Meerut route; the article says the 82 km journey 'can now be completed' in 55 minutes, an expected time, not a measured one (district-level)

Survey statement (Hindi): बेगमपुल में नमो भारत स्टेशन शुरू हो गया, सफर का नया विकल्प
Voter says (English): A Namo Bharat station at Begumpul has started operating, giving people a new travel option
Basis: Wikipedia: 'The station is operational since 22 February 2026' (infobox also lists 22 Feb 2026); Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026) names Begumpul as a main station (district-level)

Survey statement (Hindi): बेगमपुल और भैंसाली के सभी गेट खुले, अब स्टेशन में आना-जाना आसान
Voter says (English): All gates at Begumpul and Bhainsali metro stations are now open, so entry and exit is easier
Basis: Newsprahari (no date printed; URL indicates May 2026): NCRTC 'सभी गेट को खोल दिया है'; two Begumpul gates and one Bhainsali gate had stayed shut even after inauguration. 'Easier' is a paraphrase of the opened gates

Survey statement (Hindi): *बेगमपुल से मेट्रो की सुविधा मिलने लगी
Voter says (English): *Metro service is now available from Begumpul
Basis: Inference: the Amar Ujala article lists Begumpul in the Meerut Metro timetable; the source does not measure daily use or ridership, and no delivered AC-specific positive beyond transit was found

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में लिसाड़ी गेट, बेगमपुल की गलियों में पानी भरता, नाले फेल
Voter says (English): In rain the lanes of Lisari Gate and Begumpul get waterlogged and drains fail
Basis: MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj press releases (partisan, claims not independently verified). EIN release (5 Oct 2026): monsoon left old-city lanes of Lisari Gate and Begumpul waterlogged, families bailed water from ground-floor rooms, drainage failed in Lisari Gate. The AC-48 pledge release (dated 14/15 Aug 2026 on the page) lists Begumpul and Lisari Gate in its constituency issue map for drainage and lane-level flooding; the AC-48 link rests on this partisan release
Sources: EIN Presswire (MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj release) 2026-10-05: https://www.einpresswire.com/article/947417171/mlc-dharmendra-bhardwaj-raises-concern-as-hindon-records-zero-oxygen-at-survey-sites-near-meerut | NatLawReview (MLC Dharmender Bhardwaj AC-48 pledge release) 2026-08-14: https://natlawreview.com/press-releases/mlc-dharmender-bhardwaj-releases-six-point-pledge-meerut-city-ac-48

Survey statement (Hindi): जुलाई में सड़कें तालाब बनीं, नाले का गंदा पानी घरों में घुसा
Voter says (English): In July the roads turned into ponds and drain water got into homes
Basis: Amar Ujala (29 Jul 2026): 585.5 mm July rain, highest in 22 years; summary 'सड़कें तालाब बन गईं, नालों का गंदा पानी घरों और अस्पतालों तक पहुंच गया'. Body describes drain water entering homes at Bhumiya ka Pul and Lalkurti mohallas, and rainwater (not drain water) at the medical college OPD and emergency; Delhi Road waterlogging (city-level, not AC-specific)

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरठ की सड़कों पर गड्ढे और रोज जाम, हादसों का डर
Voter says (English): Potholes and daily jams on Meerut roads, and fear of accidents
Basis: Newsprahari (no date printed; date from URL, Oct 2026): deep potholes and waterlogging make roads risky for two-wheelers, long queues at major crossings and markets, and roads break up again soon after repair; no locality or assembly seat named (city-level)

Survey statement (Hindi): बेगमपुल और लिसाड़ी गेट के चौराहों पर लंबा जाम, आना-जाना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): Begumpul and Lisari Gate are among the crossings with long chronic jams, making travel hard
Basis: MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj release (EIN, 5 Oct 2026; partisan, not independently verified): Begumpul and Lisari Gate are among seven chronic congestion crossings. AC-48 link via the AC-48 pledge release (partisan), which lists both in its constituency issue map
Sources: EIN Presswire (MLC Dharmendra Bhardwaj release) 2026-10-05: https://www.einpresswire.com/article/947417171/mlc-dharmendra-bhardwaj-raises-concern-as-hindon-records-zero-oxygen-at-survey-sites-near-meerut | NatLawReview (MLC Dharmender Bhardwaj AC-48 pledge release) 2026-08-14: https://natlawreview.com/press-releases/mlc-dharmender-bhardwaj-releases-six-point-pledge-meerut-city-ac-48

Survey statement (Hindi): किदवई नगर में आग, एक परिवार के छह लोगों की जान गई
Voter says (English): Fire in Kidwai Nagar killed six members of one family
Basis: Amar Ujala (24 Feb 2026): fire late on Monday 23 Feb at a textile trader's house in Kidwai Nagar Islamabad, Lisari Gate police station area, killed six members of one family; the report calls Rafiq Ansari the 'शहर विधायक' who visited the victims, which places Kidwai Nagar in the city seat by news report (AC-specific). 'Worries people' is a paraphrase

Survey statement (Hindi): जयभीम नगर, सराय काजी और मयूर विहार में नालों का काम शुरू हुआ
Voter says (English): Drain work has started in Jaibhim Nagar, Sarai Kazi and Mayur Vihar
Basis: Amar Ujala, 6 Oct 2025 (opened and verified): mayor inaugurated about Rs 8.5 crore of works in the 'मेरठ दक्षिण विधानसभा क्षेत्र'. Three drains (about Rs 5.69 crore) in Jaibhim Nagar, Takshshila Colony, Sarai Kazi, Mayur Vihar and Jagriti Vihar Sector 8 were inaugurated; the article says the drains are 'to be built' (बनने वाले).

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरठ दक्षिण में आठ सड़कों का काम शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Work on eight roads in Meerut South has started
Basis: Same Amar Ujala report (opened and verified): 'इसके अलावा आठ सड़कों का भी उद्घाटन किया है'. No separate rupee figure for the eight roads. The article names the Meerut South assembly constituency.

Survey statement (Hindi): सात साल बाद मेरठ को नमो भारत और मेट्रो मिली
Voter says (English): After seven years, Meerut got Namo Bharat and Metro
Basis: Amar Ujala, 22 Feb 2026 (opened and verified): PM and CM dedicated the Namo Bharat rapid corridor and Meerut Metro; 'सात साल से चल रहा इंतजार समाप्त हो गया'. Namo Bharat service had already started on a 55 km stretch. City-wide project; the article names no vidhan sabha.

Survey statement (Hindi): शास्त्रीनगर एल-ब्लॉक में पंप लगवाकर जलभराव का पानी निकलवाया
Voter says (English): Pumps were installed in Shastri Nagar L-Block and the waterlogged water was drained
Basis: Amar Ujala, 24 May 2026 (opened and verified): mayor visited Shastri Nagar L-Block, 'वहां पंपिंग सेट लगवाकर पानी की निकासी कराई'; the article says the waterlogging problem was resolved 'तत्काल'. AC membership unconfirmed: the article names no vidhan sabha and I could not confirm Shastri Nagar lies inside Meerut South.

Voter says (English): Delhi-Meerut RRTS station at Muradnagar makes travel to Delhi easier

Sources: DD News 2024-03-05: https://ddnews.gov.in/%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%8F%E0%A4%AE-%E0%A4%AE%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%80-%E0%A4%AC%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%A7%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0-%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%8B-%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%97/ | Wikipedia (Murad Nagar RRTS station) 2024-03-07: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murad_Nagar_RRTS_station

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड 23 में नाली का काम शुरू हुआ, पर धीमी चाल से
Voter says (English): Drain work has started in Ward 23, though it is moving slowly
Basis: Ward 23 of Muradnagar Nagar Palika, Naya Nooraganj Eidgah road: drain construction started, but less than half is built and work has been stop-start for about two months (Amar Ujala, 22 Jul 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): इदगाह बस्ती में पानी की नई टंकी बन रही है
Voter says (English): A new water tank is under construction in Idgah Basti
Basis: Residents say pipeline laying runs from Ramlila Ground at Chungi No. 3 to a water tank under construction in Idgah Basti, Muradnagar; the article describes this in a pipeline-damage report and does not report residents appreciating it.

Survey statement (Hindi): * मुरादनगर की छह सड़कों की मरम्मत की योजना है
Voter says (English): * Six Muradnagar roads are planned for renovation under a Rs 81 crore district plan
Basis: Inference: district-level Rs 81 crore PWD estimate for 34 roads plus four bridges; article says six roads in Muradnagar, none named, and one bridge proposed there. Estimate not yet approved; work starts only after approval (Amar Ujala, 26 Sep 2025). Not a completed benefit. A search for a completed Muradnagar road project in 2026 found nothing.

Survey statement (Hindi): सावन में गंगनहर घाट पर रोज़ गंगा महाआरती हुई
Voter says (English): Daily Ganga maha-aarti was held at Gangnahar ghat during Sawan
Basis: Namami Gange district team held a daily Ganga maha-aarti at Gangnahar ghat, Muradnagar, from 30 July to 12 August 2026; the aarti has run every Wednesday and Saturday since 7 June 2025 (Amar Ujala, 31 Jul 2026). A faith event, not a service.

Survey statement (Hindi): पाइपलाइन टूटी, कई दिनों से पानी नहीं, खुदाई से दिन भर जाम
Voter says (English): Pipeline broke, no water for days, and road digging keeps traffic jammed all day
Basis: Pipeline damaged for 3-4 days on Pipeline Road near Sarna Chowk, Chungi No. 3, Muradnagar; article says about 7,000-8,000 people affected; road digging keeps traffic jammed all day; EO says supply will be restored soon, no date given.

Survey statement (Hindi): भीषण गर्मी में तीन दिन बिजली बंद, महिलाएं सब-स्टेशन पहुंचीं
Voter says (English): Three days without power in scorching heat, women gathered at the substation
Basis: Power halted for three days in six colonies (Radheshyam Vihar, Shivam Vihar, Shankar Vihar, Asalatnagar, Shobhapur and others), reported as Muradnagar; women went to the Asalatnagar substation; SDO said supply would be restored once the fault was fixed, no timeline given. Asalatnagar village membership unconfirmed; counted as Muradnagar namesake. (Amar Ujala, 23 May 2025.)

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड 23 की नाली रुक-रुक कर बन रही है, गंदा पानी भरता है
Voter says (English): Drain in Ward 23 is being built stop-start, and dirty water collects in the lanes
Basis: Ward 23, Muradnagar NPP, Naya Nooraganj Eidgah road: work on and off for about two months, less than half built; Mahtab Pathan (UP Minority Congress secretary) says work has been completely halted for about 15 days; contractor dumped soil making road slippery; residents want the current contractor's tender cancelled (Amar Ujala, 22 Jul 2026). Waterlogging from the clogged drain is the article's account of residents' complaint.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगनहर घाट पर हर साल बड़ी संख्या में लोग डूबते हैं
Voter says (English): Large numbers drown at the Gangnahar ghat every year
Basis: Article says, per departmental data, a large number of people drown at the Muradnagar Ganga canal ghat every year (no figure given). Rs 5 crore canal-bed raise budget is sanctioned at state level; iron chains and railings are planned; work has not started and needs a canal water shutdown and tender (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): श्मशान घाट हादसे के पीड़ित परिवारों को नौकरी-मकान नहीं मिला
Voter says (English): Families of crematorium collapse victims say they have not received a government job or house
Basis: Roof of a corridor at the Ukhlarsi Bamba Road crematorium, Muradnagar, collapsed on 3 Jan 2021 (25 dead per article). A year later families said no government job or house had been given; they held a dharna at Nagar Palika and a rotating hunger strike; they say accused were released (families' claim, not confirmed by article). Ukhlarsi village membership unconfirmed; counted as Muradnagar namesake. Report dated 3 Jan 2022. No 2024-2026 update found, so persistence after 2022 is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): नमो भारत चलने से साहिबाबाद से दिल्ली और मेरठ जाना आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): Namo Bharat train from Sahibabad station has made travel to Delhi and Meerut easier
Basis: Wikipedia: Sahibabad RRTS station was commissioned on 20 October 2023 and opened to the public on 21 October 2023; run by NCRTC on solar power (1,100 roof panels). District-level; AC membership of the station not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): वसुंधरा फ्लाईओवर से मोहन नगर से यूपी गेट बिना रुके पहुंच जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Vasundhara flyover lets Mohan Nagar traffic reach UP Gate without stopping
Basis: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019): Rs 49 crore Vasundhara flyover opened; it provides travel from the Mohan Nagar side to UP Gate without any stoppage. 2019 source, district-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * राजेंद्र नगर में नाला बनने वाला है, बारिश का पानी निकलेगा
Voter says (English): * Drain work in Rajendra Nagar will start so rainwater can drain away
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026) says the tender for the RCC drain and road in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 is complete and construction is to begin within 10 days. Not yet a delivered benefit; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * इंदिरापुरम और वसुंधरा से इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया जाना आसान होगा
Voter says (English): * Easier to reach the industrial area from Indirapuram and Vasundhara
Basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019) says the flyover will let Indirapuram and Vasundhara residents reach Industrial Area Site 4 without jams. This is the article's expectation, not a resident quote; 2019 source, AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * मेट्रो और नमो भारत पास होने से ऑटो से आना-जाना आसान है
Voter says (English): * Easy to get to Metro and Namo Bharat stations by auto from here
Basis: Inference: no source found on auto access or station connectivity for this AC. The Wikipedia station page was removed as a source because it does not state this.

Survey statement (Hindi): 1700 फैक्ट्रियों का गंदा पानी साहिबाबाद के नाले से यमुना में जाता है
Voter says (English): Waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain
Basis: ETV Bharat (28 July 2025): waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain, which flows through Sahibabad Industrial Area Site-4; BOD 220 mg/l, ideal 30 mg/l per the article. District-level; Site-4 AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में राजेंद्र नगर सेक्टर-5 में पानी भरता है, सड़कें टूटी हैं
Voter says (English): Rainwater collects in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 and roads are damaged
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: water collects at several spots in Sector-5 during rain and waterlogging has damaged the roads; the article says about 30,000 people will directly benefit from the project. AC membership of Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): टूटी सड़क से गाड़ियां गुजरती हैं तो धूल उड़ती है
Voter says (English): Vehicles passing the broken road in Sahibabad industrial area kick up dust
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (30 Oct 2025): road broken near Indraprastha Dental College in Sahibabad industrial area; vehicles passing over it kick up dust. Short report, no resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़क किनारे कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है और धुआं फैलता है
Voter says (English): Garbage piles along roads in Site IV industrial area catch fire and send smoke
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (12 Apr 2025): roadside garbage on fire in Sahibabad Site IV industrial area, smoke rising. Short report, no official or resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिले की 120 फैक्ट्रियों ने चिमनी पर फिल्टर नहीं लगाए, दूसरा नोटिस
Voter says (English): 120 factories in the district did not install chimney filters and got a second notice
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: UPPCB issued a second notice to 120 industrial units in Ghaziabad district to install chimney filters, deadline 30 September 2026. District-level, not AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर से बागू तक गांमी पुल की नींव रख दी गई
Voter says (English): The foundation has been laid for the Gamni bridge from Vijay Nagar to Bagu
Basis: Star Express News (22 Sep 2026): MP Atul Garg and city MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid the foundation for a bridge of about Rs 13 crore over the Delhi-Meerut Expressway, linking Vijay Nagar with Krishna Nagar-Bagu; ceremony at Vijay Nagar Bypass; completion targeted in about one year. Foundation only, not built. AC membership inferred from the Vijay Nagar location (see notes).

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर में सड़क और पार्क के 1.26 करोड़ के काम शुरू हुए
Voter says (English): Road and park works worth about Rs 1.26 crore have started in Vijay Nagar
Basis: Udaybhoomi (14 Jul 2026): Mayor Sunita Dayal and MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid foundation stones for four works costing about Rs 1.26 crore in Vijay Nagar: a green belt boundary wall in Ward 14 (Sarvodaya Nagar) and Ward 15, Shastri Park development (no ward given), and road construction in Ward 35 (Akbarpur Beharampur). Launched, not completed. Ward 15 and 35 are on the AC ward list; Ward 14 is not.

Survey statement (Hindi): हिंडन एलिवेटेड रोड बन गई, राजनगर एक्सटेंशन से यूपी गेट तक चलती है
Voter says (English): The Hindon Elevated Road has been built and runs from Rajnagar Extension to UP Gate
Basis: Wikipedia: 10.3 km grade-separated road from Raj Nagar Extension (city) to UP Gate at the Delhi border, in operation since March 2018. Older than 2024-2026 but a delivered benefit. AC membership of the stretch is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): CC road work has started at the district hospital
Basis: Upabtak (16 Jul 2025): MLA Sanjeev Sharma inaugurated CC road work at the District Hospital (MMG), from the TB department to the mortuary; the MLA's media adviser said it would be completed soon. Started, not completed. The article does not state the hospital's AC; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): विधायक ने शौचालयों की सफाई के लिए नगर निगम को चिट्ठी लिखी
Voter says (English): The MLA has written a letter to the corporation about cleaning the toilets
Basis: Weak positive, a demand with no action: Jan Sagar Today (29 Aug 2026): MLA Sanjeev Sharma wrote to the Municipal Commissioner seeking regular, scheduled cleaning and repair of more than 50 public toilets in the Shahar assembly constituency. The article says attention is now on the corporation's response; no corporation action is reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में अंडरपास और सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): When it rains, underpasses and roads fill with water and jams build up
Basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026, rain on 5 Sep): the NH-9 underpass in Vijaynagar Industrial Area was closed by water; about one foot of water in Karpuri Puram; water in Govindpuram and Vijayanagar sectors 3 and 9; main road jammed for about half an hour. TNP News (17 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Sadar seat): waterlogging, poor drainage and traffic jams listed as major election issues. Only the Vijaynagar underpass is named as inside Vijay Nagar; Karpuri Puram and Govindpuram AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर सेक्टर 12 में सड़कों पर गड्ढे हैं, नालियां साफ नहीं होतीं
Voter says (English): In Vijay Nagar Sector 12 roads have potholes and the drains are not cleaned
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026), Vijayanagar Sector 12 C Block (about 7,000 residents): resident Shekhar said there are big potholes and accidents and complaints go unheeded; Rahul Singh said drains not being cleaned cause major problems in the rainy season. Ward councillor Omveer Singh Odh said repair work is ongoing and the remaining issues will be fixed soon. No ward number is given for Sector 12.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजयनगर निकासी पर रोज जान जोखिम में डालकर सड़क पार करनी पड़ती है
Voter says (English): Every day we have to cross the road at the Vijaynagar exit, risking our lives
Basis: Udaybhoomi (4 Sep 2025): residents say they must cross the expressway daily at risk to their lives; the article says a traffic policeman died in an accident near the Vijaynagar exit earlier. Gadkari has directed officials to begin an overbridge process; this is a direction, not a built overbridge.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर का पुल पांच साल में भी तैयार नहीं हुआ
Voter says (English): The Vijay Nagar bridge is still not ready even after five years
Basis: Amar Ujala city-seat issues section (2022 election page; the text is undated): the bridge connecting Vijay Nagar and the city is not ready even after five years. No 2026 report found confirming the bridge's status, so treat as possibly stale.

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर 12 में पीने के पानी और बिजली कटौती की दिक्कत रहती है
Voter says (English): In Sector 12, drinking water and power cuts are a constant problem
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026): resident Rajeev said drinking water and power cuts have been persistent problems and complaints get no response. Single resident's statement.

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर नॉर्थ तक रैपिड रेल चलने से सफर आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): The rapid rail now reaches Modinagar North and the trip has become easier
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Mar 2024, verified): PM virtually inaugurated the 17 km Duhai to Modinagar North section; regular passenger service was to start 8 March at 6 AM; NCRTC officials give 24 minutes from Sahibabad to Modinagar North. Wikipedia station page (verified): station is in Modinagar town, Ghaziabad district, inaugurated 6 March 2024

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर से सराय काले खां तक रैपिड रेल से जा सकते हैं
Voter says (English): From Modinagar you can now take rapid rail to Sarai Kale Khan
Basis: Amar Ujala (20 Feb 2026, verified): the Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat line now extends from Sarai Kale Khan to Begumpul. The article does not mention Modinagar; the link to Modinagar North comes from the Wikipedia station page (verified), whose infobox shows Platform 2 toward Sarai Kale Khan. Line-level fact, not a Modinagar-only change

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर की कई गलियों में स्ट्रीट लाइट लगी है
Voter says (English): *Many lanes in Modinagar have street lights
Basis: Inference: SquareYards locality page (undated, verified) says the locality is well-lit with street lamps in multiple areas. Listing-site summary, not a news report or official source

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर के कई इलाकों में सड़कें अच्छी बनी हैं
Voter says (English): *Roads in many parts of Modinagar are well built
Basis: Inference: SquareYards page (undated, verified) lists 'Well Built Roads with Sidewalk' as a positive from reviews, but its overview also says residents dislike the poor road conditions, so this is contested

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर स्टेशन पर गाड़ी पार्क करने की सुविधा है
Voter says (English): *Modinagar station has a parking facility for cars
Basis: Inference: Wikipedia station page (verified) infobox lists Accessible: Yes and Four-Wheeler Parking. A facility fact, not a voter-voiced benefit

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर-कलछीना सड़क सिर्फ 3.75 मीटर चौड़ी है, जगह-जगह टूटी है
Voter says (English): The Modinagar-Kalchhina road is only 3.75 metres wide and broken in many places
Basis: Amar Ujala (3 Aug 2026, verified): road is 3.75 m wide, damaged in many places, aggregate has come loose; 14.5 km road serves more than 50,000 people in villages along it. Widening (to 5.5 m, about Rs 35 crore) is proposed, not approved. AC membership unconfirmed: the Modinagar end is inside the AC, but Kalchhina village is not confirmed inside it (one postal listing says Hapur tehsil), so not counted in ac_specific_negatives

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश में मोदीनगर की गलियों में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): *In the rainy season water fills up the lanes of Modinagar
Basis: Inference: SquareYards page (verified) quotes reviewers saying the area sees heavy waterlogging in peak rainy seasons and lacks proper drainage. Reviews are undated except Nov 2022 and are not a news report. No 2024-26 Modinagar news on waterlogging was found (a ghaziabad365 Modinagar drain-repair item returned 404 and is not used)

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर में बच्चा उठाने की कोशिश हुई, पुलिस ने रिपोर्ट नहीं लिखी
Voter says (English): An attempt was made to take a child away in Modinagar, and police did not file a report
Basis: Amar Ujala video (16 Sep 2026, verified): the headline says abduction but the body describes an attempt; a neighbour followed and the suspects fled leaving the child; CCTV footage has surfaced; police had not registered an FIR two days after the incident. Lane is in Modinagar town (inside the AC)

Survey statement (Hindi): ड्यूटी से लौटते एक युवक को मोदीनगर में सड़क पर रोककर पीटा गया
Voter says (English): A youth returning from duty was stopped on a Modinagar road and beaten up
Basis: Amar Ujala video (15 Feb 2026, verified): headline 'Modinagar mein duty se laut rahe yuvak ki pitai'; a youth returning from duty was stopped on the road by some people and beaten severely. Attackers, cause and injuries not stated; no arrest or follow-up named. Modinagar town is inside the AC (Wikipedia AC extent: KC Modinagar, Modinagar MB)

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर तहसील में कूड़ा है, दीवारों पर पान के दाग हैं
Voter says (English): Garbage is piled up at the Modinagar tehsil office, with pan stains on the walls
Basis: Amar Ujala impact story (6 Oct 2026, verified): the Modinagar tehsil premises were covered in garbage, walls stained with pan spit, empty beer cans found; cleanup work at the tehsil has since started after the report, so this may be fixed. Tehsil office is in Modinagar town (inside the AC)

Survey statement (Hindi): *पिलखुवा के चार वार्डों में सड़क-नाली के लिए टेंडर निकल गए हैं
Voter says (English): *Tenders have been issued for roads and drains in four Pilkhuwa wards
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (24 Aug 2026, opened) says Rs 2.25 crore for about 2.5 km of roads and drains in Pilkhuwa wards 2, 3, 5 and 6; tenders issued, work planned to start end-September. No later source confirms the start. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): *धौलाना की 18 सड़कों की मरम्मत का प्रस्ताव भेजा गया है
Voter says (English): *A proposal to repair 18 roads in Dhaulana has been sent
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026, opened) says PWD sent MLA Dharmesh Tomar's proposal for special repair of 18 roads in the Dhaulana area, about Rs 6 crore; work starts only after state approval. Proposal only, not delivered. Named routes: Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road and the Badnauli route; Dhaulana KC and Dasna NP are inside the AC extent per Wikipedia.

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश में पालिका की टीम पानी भरे इलाकों में भेजी गई
Voter says (English): *During rain, a municipal team was sent to waterlogged areas
Basis: Inference: Executive Officer Indrapal Singh is quoted in Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026, opened) saying the municipal team was sent immediately to waterlogged areas during rain and drainage work is underway. An official claim only, not verified on the ground; not counted as a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हापुड़ चुंगी पर फ्लाईओवर 1200 मीटर तक बढ़ाने की योजना है
Voter says (English): *There is a plan to extend the Hapur Chungi flyover to 1200 metres
Basis: Inference: Daily Jagran (28 Aug 2025, archived page, opened) says the flyover will be extended to 1200 m from the initial 800 m, funded by PWD, a plan only. The article names Ghaziabad localities (Raj Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Sanjay Nagar, Kavi Nagar) and not Dhaulana. Hapur Chungi is not named in the Wikipedia extent; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *पिलखुवा में नाले पूरे बने तो बारिश का पानी सड़क पर नहीं रुकेगा
Voter says (English): *If the Pilkhuwa drains are fully built rainwater will not stay on the roads
Basis: Inference: no sourced completion date or outcome. Drawn from the Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026) report that waterlogging was caused by drains not being cleaned on time and inadequate drainage arrangements.

Survey statement (Hindi): पिलखुवा की रेलवे रोड, गांधी रोड पर बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): In Pilkhuwa, water fills Railway Road and Gandhi Road when it rains
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026, opened): waterlogging in several Pilkhuwa neighbourhoods and roads including Railway Road, Gandhi Road, Gandhi Bazaar and Jawahar Bazaar; the article attributes it to drains not cleaned on time and inadequate drainage. Residents are not quoted directly. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): परतापुर रोड का अंडरपास अधूरा, इसाद नगर-सद्दीकपुरा में पानी और गंदगी
Voter says (English): The Partapur Road underpass is unfinished, and there is water and filth in Isad Nagar-Saddikpura
Basis: Pratahkal (12 Oct 2026, opened): the Partapur Road underpass in Pilkhuwa is under construction and has stalled, causing waterlogging and filth for thousands in Isad Nagar and Saddikpura; AAP threatens a sit-in at the municipal premises. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): गन्ने का पिछले सत्र का पूरा बकाया न मिलने से किसान नाराज हैं
Voter says (English): Farmers are angry that the previous season's full sugarcane dues have not been paid
Basis: District-level: Amar Ujala (6 Oct 2026, opened) reports a Sambhawali sugarcane committee meeting where farmer organisations demanded full previous-season dues, cash or 14-day payment for the next season, and threatened a lockout of the sugar mill. The mill is not named and no dues figure is given; AC membership of the location is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): धौलाना की कई सड़कों की विशेष मरम्मत की जरूरत है
Voter says (English): Many Dhaulana roads need special repair
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026, opened): PWD proposal for special repair of 18 roads in the Dhaulana area (about Rs 6 crore), including the Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road and the Badnauli route. The article gives no condition details beyond the need for special repair. Dhaulana KC and Dasna NP are inside the AC extent per Wikipedia.

Survey statement (Hindi): परतापुर में फैक्ट्रियों के धुएं की शिकायत है
Voter says (English): There are complaints about factory smoke in Partapur
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Apr 2026, opened): a complaint about smoke was received; five people were booked; three units (Moon Processors, Shri Rama Industries, Shri Balaji Processors) were found burning plastic waste in boilers and their boilers and plants were sealed. The article does not quote villagers. It places Partapur in the Kotwali area, Pilkhuwa. Partapur's AC membership is unconfirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर रोड का नया ट्रांसफार्मर लगा, सुबह बिजली लौट आई
Voter says (English): Modinagar Road area got a new transformer and power came back by morning
Basis: Amar Ujala reports that after a night-long power problem in localities linked to the Modinagar Road power station, a new transformer was installed overnight and power was restored on Wednesday morning (8 Jul 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में डायलिसिस शुरू हुई, अब मरीजों को मेरठ-दिल्ली नहीं जाना पड़ता
Voter says (English): Dialysis unit opened at district hospital, kidney patients no longer need Meerut or Delhi
Basis: Pratahkal and Khabarwala24 (both 28 Sep 2026) report a new dialysis unit at the Hapur district hospital on Modinagar Road, Hapur city (Hapur MB, inside the AC), inaugurated by the Hapur Sadar MLA. Patients earlier had to travel to Meerut, Delhi or Ghaziabad for regular dialysis; the unit now treats them locally

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में गंभीर मरीजों के लिए अलग पूरा वार्ड है
Voter says (English): District hospital has a separate full ward for serious patients
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 May 2026) quotes a CHC doctor: "जिला अस्पताल में अलग से पूरा वार्ड है" - the district hospital has a separate complete ward, and serious cases are sent there from the CHC (10 emergency beds in the CHC emergency area). Khabarwala24 places the district hospital on Modinagar Road in Hapur city, inside Hapur MB

Survey statement (Hindi): डासना से हापुड़ तक छह लेन सड़क खुली, सफर आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): The six-lane road from Dasna to Hapur has opened, and the trip has become easier
Basis: Patrika (30 Sep 2019) reports Nitin Gadkari inaugurated the 22.30 km six-lane Dasna to Hapur national highway with two-lane service roads on each side, and that travel towards Moradabad and Meerut via Hapur became easier. District-level and old; the article does not say whether it passes Hapur city

Survey statement (Hindi): *हापुड़ ब्लॉक की सड़कों की मरम्मत के टेंडर निकले हैं
Voter says (English): *Road repair tenders have been issued for the Hapur block
Basis: Inference, not an appreciated delivered benefit: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026) reports PWD tenders totalling Rs 75 lakh for five district road repairs (about Rs 15 lakh each; Hapur among the places named). The article names no road or village in the AC, does not say work has started, and no completed local work was found. Kept only as a flagged placeholder for field check

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में स्वर्ग आश्रम रोड और दोयमी फाटक पर पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): When it rains, water fills Swarg Ashram Road and Doyami Phatak
Basis: DM Kavita Meena inspected waterlogging on LN Public School Road and Swarg Ashram Road, which daily troubles thousands of schoolchildren; she reprimanded municipal officials (28 Sep 2026). At Doyami Phatak on Swarg Ashram Road the drain work is incomplete and rainwater stands on the road (29 Sep 2026). Doyami is a polling circle listed in the AC extent

Survey statement (Hindi): मंडी मोहल्ले में 36 घंटे पानी बंद रहा, एक टैंकर काफी नहीं था
Voter says (English): Mandi mohalla had no water for 36 hours, and one tanker was not enough
Basis: Mohalla Mandi, Hapur Nagar Palika area, was without drinking water for about 36 hours; residents allege the Nagar Palika did not act seriously despite complaints, and say one tanker was insufficient for hundreds of houses. No Nagar Palika statement in the article (24 May 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): अतरपुरा बिजलीघर ढाई घंटे बंद, आठ हजार से ज्यादा घरों की बिजली गई
Voter says (English): Atarpura power station was shut for 2.5 hours and more than 8,000 homes lost power
Basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026): Atarpura power station, fed from the 220 kV Anand Vihar station, was shut for about 2.5 hours on Wednesday, cutting supply to more than 8,000 homes. The district lacks fault locator machines so linemen patrol lines by hand. Atarpura localities (Swarg Ashram Road, Gol Market, Sarraf Bazar, Chandi Road) are Hapur city areas

Survey statement (Hindi): चहकमाल में मंजूर ट्रांसफार्मर अब तक नहीं लगा, पानी भी कम
Voter says (English): The sanctioned 250 KVA transformer for Chahkamal has still not been installed, and water is also short
Basis: Residents of Mohalla Chahkamal in Hapur town say a sanctioned 250 KVA transformer has not been installed and drinking water is short; they gave a memorandum to the DM, who promised action within seven days. The article does not say whether this was done (5 Oct 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): ओम विहार की टूटी सड़क पर गंदा पानी रहता है, शिकायतें अनसुनी
Voter says (English): The broken road in Om Vihar has dirty water standing on it, and complaints go unheard
Basis: Residents of Om Vihar Colony on Station Asaura Road, Hapur, say the about 100 m main road is broken and dirty drain water always stands on it; they complained several times and gave a memorandum to the DM with no action taken (26 Sep 2026). Asaura is listed in the AC extent (Hapur KC group, Wikipedia), but the colony's exact location is not confirmed beyond Hapur, so it is counted conservatively as not AC-specific. The Royal Bulletin URL carries a draft-style slug and the byline date (26 Sep 2026) conflicts with some related-story dates on the page

Survey statement (Hindi): *टूटी सड़कों की मरम्मत के टेंडर निकल गए हैं
Voter says (English): *Tenders have been issued to repair the broken roads
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (5 May 2025) reports Hapur-Pilkhuwa Development Authority tenders for repair of the Jawaharganj Mandi road in Garhmukteshwar (Rs 55.56 lakh) and two Brajghat roads (Rs 95.07 lakh and Rs 64.62 lakh); work was planned to start in June. The article does not say Brajghat is in the town. No start or completion is confirmed, and the source is from 2025.

Survey statement (Hindi): *गंगा मेले में हर घाट पर पुलिस चौकी बनी, सुरक्षा का इंतजाम हुआ
Voter says (English): *Police posts were set up at every ghat at the Ganga fair for security
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Nov 2025) reports police stations and chowkis in every sector and at every ghat, dog squads, metal detectors, and strict security around the women's ghats at the Garhmukteshwar Ganga fair. The article does not say watch towers are at the women's ghats. It has no devotee feedback, so how people felt about it is not sourced.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे चालू हो गया, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर का इंटरचेंज भी है
Voter says (English): The Ganga Expressway has opened and there is also a Garhmukteshwar interchange
Basis: District-level: Wikipedia says the Ganga Expressway was inaugurated on 29 April 2026 and lists a Phase 1 diamond interchange at NH-24 (Hapur-Garhmukteshwar). The page does not say how the interchange affects travel in Garhmukteshwar, so the local benefit is not stated by the source.

Survey statement (Hindi): *गांवों तक के रास्ते सुधरें तो खेत और मंडी तक पहुंच आसान हो
Voter says (English): *If village roads are improved, reaching fields and mandis would be easier
Basis: Inference: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026) reports BKU demanding repair of dilapidated village roads in Garhmukteshwar tehsil. No source found that these roads have been repaired, so improvement is a hope, not a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): *पुलिस चौकियों और गश्त से लोगों को सुरक्षा का भरोसा मिले
Voter says (English): *Police patrols and posts give people a sense of safety
Basis: Inference: the Ganga Fair police arrangements are sourced (positive 2). No source records public feeling of safety in the AC, so this is a guess.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिलों पर गन्ने का पैसा अटका, किसान कर्ज़ में दबे हैं
Voter says (English): Sugarcane money is stuck with the mills, and farmers are under debt
Basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): BKU tractor march and dharna at Garhmukteshwar tehsil, demanding payment of cane dues with interest and a higher cane price for the new season. Source says: 'समय पर पैसा न मिलने से किसान कर्ज के बोझ तले दब रहा है'. No amount owed, mill name or payment schedule is stated. The protest was at tehsil premises; Wikipedia's Garhmukteshwar page says the tehsil headquarters is in the town (AC namesake), so it is counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा गोवंश और बंदर फसल चौपट कर रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Stray cattle and monkeys are destroying crops
Basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): same BKU protest at Garhmukteshwar tehsil demanded relief from stray cattle and monkeys damaging standing crops. No count of animals or area is stated. Tehsil-wide demand; AC membership of the specific place is not confirmed, so not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा का पानी बढ़ा, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर के कई इलाकों में बाढ़ जैसे हालात
Voter says (English): Ganga water has risen and parts of Garhmukteshwar are in flood-like conditions
Basis: Asianet Newsable (23 Aug 2026, 12:03 PM IST) states: 'The rising water level of the Ganga has triggered a flood-like situation in parts of Garhmukteshwar, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh.' No villages, ghats, roads or figures are named. Named place is the AC namesake town.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली विभाग जांच के नाम पर किसानों को परेशान करने का आरोप है
Voter says (English): Farmers allege the power department harasses them in the name of checks
Basis: Allegation only, as put in the BKU memorandum (Khabarwala, 8 Oct 2026): the power department harasses farmers in rural areas under the cover of checking. The source does not use the words 'power theft'. Tehsil-wide; AC membership unconfirmed; no village or case named. Not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): कांवड़ मेला क्षेत्र में गंदगी और अव्यवस्था दिखी
Voter says (English): Dirt and disorder seen in the Kanwar fair area
Basis: Amar Ujala video page (29 Jul 2026): Divisional Commissioner inspected the Kanwar mela area at Brijghat, Garhmukteshwar, said 'यह क्या तैयारी है, हम यहां ये अव्यवस्था देखने के लिए आए हैं', and found dirt and disorder at several places (no spots named). The article text is cut off. Brijghat is placed inside the AC by Bharatpedia (aggregator): 'Nagar Palika Parishad Garhmukteshwar (City + Brijghat)'.
